Absorbing Replication

Grunge (Wildstorm Comics) has the ability to molecularly bond with anything he comes in contact with. Once he bonds with an object he takes on its physical characteristics. For example, if he bonds with steel he gains increased strength and durability. But this power goes just beyond matter. He can absorb skills, powers, & even the essence of a pocket dimension becoming almighty in said realm.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb and replicate anything.
"But how could one defeat such a being? Wouldn't anything you threw at him become a weapon in his own defense?"
― Captain Mar-Vell

The ability to absorb and replicate anything. Combination of Absorption, Adaptive Replication, and Shapeshifting. Advanced version of Digestive Assimilation.

  • Optimal Sentient System
  • Ultimate Lifeform

Capabilities[]

Users can absorb any material, energy, and living beings they come into contact with. Through this, they gain the capacity to replicate and encode the properties of what they touch, integrating them into their own being. These properties become part of a vast internal arsenal, ready to be accessed and utilized as needed.

This ability allows the user to briefly merge with materials or beings, memorizing their structure and essence without causing harm. Alternatively, they can choose to assimilate the target fully, empowering themselves with new abilities or enhancing existing ones. Each act of absorption becomes an opportunity for evolution, turning even an attack into a chance for growth.

The power's most striking aspects is its adaptability and versatility. Users can reshape their bodies to reflect the properties they absorb, altering their form to suit any situation. They can generate weapons and tools based on the traits of absorbed materials, wielding them with precision and ingenuity. Beyond replication, the ability allows for recombination—absorbed traits can be blended into entirely new and unique capabilities, enabling the creation of forms and functions beyond what was initially taken.

This absorption process is not only a means of defense but also a strategic advantage, as it converts attacks against the user into opportunities for growth and evolution. At advanced levels, they can reverse the process, transferring absorbed properties to others or even reconstructing absorbed beings and objects.

Applications (Contextual)[]

Combat:[]

  • Ability Information Archiving - Absorb, imprint and catalogue various power & abilities.
    • Ability Transcendence - Evolve ones powers & abilities to its ultimate limits.
    • Meta Ability Creation - Generate new fantastical powers & abilities based on absorbed data.
    • Power Bestowal/Power Transferal - Give one's powers & abilities to others.
    • Power Refining - Recombine, customize, upgrade and boost powers & abilities into new ones.
  • Bullet Propulsion - Project bullets directly from the body.
    • Bullet Hell - Rain down multiple ranged attacks at once.
    • Projectile Enhancement - By bestowing properties.
    • Targeting - Bullet guiding via kinetic adjustments.
    • Transmutation - Rewrite target's body structure or oneself.
  • Defunct Physiology - Users have no structural weakness.
    • Absolute Stamina - Always operate at peak efficiency.
    • Pain Suppression - Never feel pain whatsoever.
    • Reforming - Nullify damage by remodeling the body.
    • Self-Sustenance - Doesn't require nutrients or rest.
  • Elemental Manipulation - Absorb and manipulate various elements.
    • Absorbing Regeneration - Draw in surrounding elements to become whole.
    • Elemental Attacks - Generate elemental energies.
    • Elemental Enhanced Condition - Use elements to enhance attributes.
    • Elemental Infusion - Empower weapons with various elements.
  • Mechanical Energy Manipulation - Absorb and manipulate mechanical energy.
    • Supernatural Condition - Boost condition via differing energies.
    • Concussive Force - Deliver concussive force via kinetic energy.
    • Invulnerability - Prevent damage via kinetic absorption.
    • Kinetic Charging - Increase projectiles' kinetic charge.
  • Size/Density Manipulation - Limited by the volume/mass accumulated.
    • Augmentation - Using accumulated intake to bolster oneself.
    • Mass Manipulation - Via intake, shunting, conversion, or transferal of extra mass.
    • Quality Enhancement - Enhance the quality of things.
    • Self-Power Augmentation - Convert resources into power boosts.
  • Tendril Generation/Blade Shifting - Generate Tendrils & Blades.
    • Binding/Power Negation - Bind anyone or anything via power nullifying.
    • Cutting/Impale - Cut & Pierce through anything via edge absorption.
    • Weaponized Body - Extruding countless lethal extremities.

Constructive:[]

  • Consciousness Transferal - Absorbing & Implanting minds.
    • Experience Mimicry - Assimilate & mimic experiences.
    • Mental Mimicry - Absorbing & replicating thoughts.
    • Personality Alteration - Shifting mental factors.
  • Hyper Mind - Process unlimited amounts of absorbed information.
    • Absolute Creativity - Expand creativity indefinitely via data.
    • Encyclopedic Knowledge - Encode any data from any source.
    • Supernatural Intelligence - Exponential intellectual capabilities.
  • Life Mastery - Create a being from a piece of the user, granting complete control.
    • Gene-Splicing - Create new genetic templates via recombination.
    • Life Creation - Generate new life forms based on absorbed data.
    • Population Control - Control any form of populated life.
  • Meta Crafting - Create any object by utilizing re-purposed absorbed data.
    • Impossible Forging - Forge anything that would be considered impossible.
    • Supernatural Properties Manipulation - Switch/Upgrade/Recombine.
    • Weaponry Refinement - Magnify properties by infusing resources.
  • Recreation - Limited to assimilated and memorized objects & entities.
    • Fusionism - Recombine properties & patterns into new ones.
    • Restoration Augmentation - Recreate anything with upgraded status.
    • Technomagic - Merge magical and technological properties.

Environment:[]

  • Construction Manipulation - Semi-independent data-based construct control & fabrication.
    • Army Manipulation - Convert landscapes into massive armies.
    • Elemental Cloning - Convert materials into additional bodies.
  • Domination - Through merging and leaving oneself within surroundings.
    • Amalgamation - Becoming control reflecting ones own image.
    • Possessive Teleportation - Taking control after previous merging.
  • Meta-Possession - Assimilate entirely with anything and everything.
    • Environmental Unity - Fusing with and spreading into the environment.
    • Symbiosis - Hosting oneself to or vice versa with ones area.
  • Tech/Data Manipulation - Fusing with technological or info wave devices.
    • Technomorphism - Take on absorbed technological properties.
    • Technological Constructs - Reconstruct absorbed technologies.

Physiology:[]

  • Adaptive Attribute Assimilation - Accommodation through physical/metaconceptual modulation.
    • Experience Manipulation - Retaining garnered knowledge for practical uses.
  • Digital Form - Emulate video and streaming signals becoming a living wavelength.
    • Mathematics Mimicry - Digitized form is composed of ever changing formula.
  • Emotional Energy Manipulation - Absorb and manipulate emotional energy.
    • Emotional Attuned Physiology - Take on emotional forms via replication.
  • Enhanced Physiology - Absorb and replicate to empower physiology by any means.
    • Superpowered Physiology - Take on superpowered advance physiology via modification.
  • Form Manipulation - To take on any unique form based on the absorbed data.
    • Transformation Mastery - To access add form without any limitations and drawbacks.
  • Imperceptibility - Undetectable via perfect environmental merging.
    • Ultimate Intangibility - Phase through obstacles by merging with them.
  • Meta-Morphic Conversion - Conjure parts of yourself to channel constructs or energy through them.
    • Living Factory - Become a living swiss-army man.
    • Living Power Plant - Become a living reactor.
  • Quantum Absorption - Absorb and manipulate higher-tier cosmic phenomena.
    • Extra-Dimensional Entity Physiology - Take on cosmic forms via replication.

Limitations[]

  • Absorption may have limited speed/range/storage.
  • Shapeshifting is limited by the mass/energy stored.
  • Transfer/reconstruction drain the user's resources.
  • Special countermeasures such as Absorption Immunity, Absorption Negation, Power Mimicry Immunity, Power Anchoring, Anti Storage makes it useless.
